items.title: Muthoot Fincorp approves Rs 4,000 crore IPO, announces stock split
items.description: Gold loan-focused NBFC plans fresh equity issue as profit nearly triples in FY26. Board also approves stock split, reducing face value of shares to Rs 2 from Rs 10.

items.title: Bond selloff threatens to knock AI stock frenzy off course
items.description: The return of AI as a key investment thesis and powerful earnings growth have fueled the frenzy, with investors setting aside worries about companies overspending.
